title: The dark tunnel
goals: Walk out at the tunnel's other end, cell (19, 1).
Check which cell you are on with `position`.
starting_code:
# Print where the wizard stands with `position` and `print`.

# Walk up to the exit's row with `move_up`.

# Walk right to the end with `move_right`.
hints: Use `print` to check where you are in this dark place!
The plan shows the exit at (19, 1), but we cannot see ourselves. Check `wizard.position`.
If it turns out we are on (15, 3), we need to take 2 steps up and 4 right.
intro: So dark! Nothing is seen in this tunnel... and for some reason, not even the map shows us. What we do see on the map is the tunnel's exit, on cell (19, 1). We can check where the wizard is, count the steps and walk blindly!
outro: We looked at where we were and walked out blind! Look, there is light up ahead.
learned: Now you know that a program sees its position even where nothing is seen.
